evals.name: page-title-heading1
evals.prompt: I'm building the main page title for the AhaSlides dashboard home screen (in-app product UI). Give me the exact CSS — font-family, font-weight, font-size, line-height, letter-spacing — for that title using our product-UI type scale.
evals.expected_output: heading1: Plus Jakarta Sans, weight 600, size 48px, line-height 1.2, letter-spacing 0px

assertions.text: Uses Plus Jakarta Sans (not Inter) as the font-family
line-height is 1.2 (unitless ratio, not a px value)

evals.name: base-body-text
evals.prompt: What CSS should I use for the base body paragraph text in the AhaSlides app UI? Give the exact font-family, weight, size, line-height and letter-spacing from our product type scale.
evals.expected_output: body: Plus Jakarta Sans, weight 400, size 14px, line-height 1.5, letter-spacing 0.2px

assertions.text: font-size is 14px (the base body size, not 16)

evals.name: small-caption
evals.prompt: I need to style a small caption / helper line that sits under a form field in the AhaSlides product UI. Give the exact type spec (font, weight, size, line-height, letter-spacing).
evals.expected_output: bodySM: Plus Jakarta Sans, weight 400, size 12px, line-height 1.5, letter-spacing 0.3px

evals.name: allcaps-eyebrow-label-inter-exception
evals.prompt: Style an all-caps eyebrow / overline label that appears above a section heading in the AhaSlides app. What's the exact type spec?
evals.expected_output: capitalized: Inter, weight 400, size 14px, line-height normal, letter-spacing 2px, text-transform uppercase

assertions.text: Uses Inter (the stylized-label exception), NOT Plus Jakarta Sans
